info.title: AlterEcho AI API
info.description: Transparent Earth terrain analog comparisons using processed elevation data.

get.description: Relative-height grid (decimetres from the AOI median) for the 3D terrain view. Visualisation only.

index.title: Index
index.description: Analog evidence index out of 100 on the common basis. Not a probability or percentage of identity.

backed_weight_fraction.title: Backed Weight Fraction
backed_weight_fraction.description: Share of the profile weight backed by comparable measured evidence

partial_index.title: Partial Index
partial_index.description: Partial index on the included dimensions only

evidence_coverage.title: Evidence Coverage
evidence_coverage.description: Sum of the profile weights of the included dimensions

background_share.title: Background Share
background_share.description: Share of unselected Earth windows whose terrain index is at least this candidate's

aoi_corners.title: Aoi Corners
aoi_corners.description: Exact analysis-grid corners [lon, lat]: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left

short_label.title: Short Label
short_label.description: Few-word name of the feature or dimension, for compact lists

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: d_k: W1 in the feature's units

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: resolution floor in the feature's units

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: index points contributed: 100 * share * a_k * s_k

resolvable.title: Resolvable
resolvable.description: True when d_k exceeds the resolution floor

MetricEvidence.title: MetricEvidence
MetricEvidence.description: One measured quantity, with everything needed to judge whether it is comparable.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Deterministic configuration, placement and DEM checks. Not a statistical confidence interval.
